observations: The cream lowercase d keeps an open, centered counter and remains distinct from the blue-black field.

screens.observation: At the 320px floor the complete paste surface through the 10 MiB boundary is visible in the first viewport; the examples form one column and no label or word is clipped or split mid-word.

At 390px the real paste surface is the dominant first action and all three synthetic cases are visible; the first two form a balanced two-column row and the third spans the width without horizontal overflow.

The wide route is organized around one continuous input-first workbench rather than a detached illustration or card grid; the restrained hero and footer frame the functional object without a floating decorative slash.
The deployed Base64 to JSON chain, confidence, evidence, selected inspector, local result-audio boundary, and reduced-motion message remain readable in the real mobile result state.
The restrained question-mark state says that the format was not identified, does not promote a guess, and preserves a clear next-input path.
